stem.text: An electron enters a region of space where there is a uniform electric field $E$ as shown.

stem.alt: Four horizontal parallel arrows pointing right, labelled E at the right end. A short arrow labelled path of electron points right into the field from the left.

stem.text: Initially, the electron is moving parallel to, and in the direction of, the electric field.
What is the subsequent path and change of speed of the electron caused by the electric field?
